visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a dimly lit indoor parking garage with concrete pillars and visible overhead pipes. A man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a light green t-shirt, speaks directly to the camera with an animated expression. In the background, a woman in a white long-sleeved shirt and blue jeans walks toward a gold-colored scooter parked next to a silver SUV. (2) The camera angle shifts to follow the woman as she stands by the scooter. She holds a tan-colored helmet with a clear visor. The man's hand enters the frame, pointing at the woman and the vehicle. The scooter's brown seat is flipped open, revealing a storage compartment. (3) The woman puts on the helmet and fastens the strap while smiling. Graphic text overlays appear on the screen, highlighting the scooter's brand. She closes the seat, which is long and brown, and sits on the vehicle, preparing to ride. (4) The scene transitions to an outdoor road lined with large green trees and a high stone wall. The camera follows the woman from behind as she rides the scooter smoothly. The lighting is overcast daylight, casting soft shadows on the asphalt. (5) The woman stops the scooter on a sidewalk next to a green park area. The man, seen through a car window, talks to her. She points to the bike, gesturing with her gloved hands to emphasize its features like the lack of a hot exhaust pipe. (6) In a city street setting with parked cars and urban buildings, a young girl in a gray t-shirt runs excitedly toward the woman. The woman holds out a helmet for the girl. They interact near the scooter, which is parked on the side of the road. (7) The woman demonstrates the storage capacity by opening the seat. She places a large beige backpack, a purple water bottle, and a yellow plush toy into the compartment. The internal storage looks spacious and clean. (8) Both the woman and the girl are now on the scooter, wearing helmets. The woman demonstrates the dashboard and a USB charging port located near the handlebars. The girl sits behind her, holding onto her waist. (9) The woman and girl ride away into the distance. The final shot shows the man standing on a paved walkway with two young boys. The boys look up at him with teasing expressions, one pointing at him while laughing. The background includes park benches and lush greenery.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice opens the track with high energy and a bright, conversational tone. The background is a clean garage environment with minimal room tone. (2) A mechanical click sound marks the opening of the scooter seat. A light, rhythmic acoustic guitar BGM enters at approximately 115 BPM. The female voice joins, sounding cheery and enunciated. (3) A series of 'ding' sound effects punctuate the appearance of graphic text. The female voice explains the features with rising intonation. (4) Sound of tire hum and light wind noise as the scene moves outdoors. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (5) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound as the location shifts. The female voice describes the bike's quietness; the BGM dips slightly to emphasize her words. (6) A high-pitched, excited shout from a child voice signals the arrival of the daughter. The BGM maintains its upbeat tempo. (7) Sounds of plastic rustling and soft thuds occur as bags are placed in the storage bin. (8) A distinctive electric motor whirring sound is heard as the woman demonstrates the 'one-button reverse' function. (9) More 'ding' and comedic sound effects play during the final dialogue. The male voice adopts a mock-dejected tone. (10) A final 'whoosh' sound effect as the video ends, with the BGM fading out quickly after a child's teasing comment.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Yamaha CUXIE electric scooter by showcasing its practical features (storage, quietness, reverse assist, USB charging) through a humorous and relatable family scenario that emphasizes convenience and safety for parents.
